activity_summary: Heminges said the reckoning was eight-and-twenty shillings, and that Monday had been the Queen's. You told him to say it once. Burbage would not make it a total for the house. Heminges said it is the reckoning and not the coffer. You did not repeat the figure.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Heard it once and would not have it said again.

entities.name: John Heminges
entities.context: Named eight-and-twenty shillings and shut the book on the sum.

entities.name: Richard Burbage
entities.context: Refused to make it a house total.

quotes.speaker: john_heminges
quotes.text: Eight-and-twenty shillings. Monday was the Queen's.

quotes.speaker: richard_burbage
quotes.text: I am not making it a total for the house.

quotes.speaker: john_heminges
quotes.text: It is the reckoning. It is not the coffer.
